entries.text: Worked on the Little Dart Mk 12 (version 11, 85% built): mounting the VFD driver board onto the main chassis using Rusty Jr the bolt and refining the alignment of the display so it glows clearly. (used Rusty Jr, a perfectly good bolt)
tightening the mounting brackets and polishing the instrument display glass with a soft cloth
entries.why: I am itching to get that instrument panel perfect before the next test flight.
entries.detail: mounting the VFD driver board onto the main chassis using Rusty Jr the bolt and refining the alignment of the display so it glows clearly.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "A little crackle"
He heard a strange crackle on his dish. Probably nothing. Probably.

Put Tok (a little landing strut), Otto (a tiny gyroscope), Gus (a cracked navigation chip), Lorna (a cockpit switch that still clicks), Nim (a coil of copper wire), Dibs (a dented fuel cell), Fen (a cracked navigation chip), Sprocket (a scorched heat tile), Tok (half a thruster nozzle), Rusty Jr (a perfectly good bolt) on his shelf.
powering down into the charging cradle
entries.why: my battery levels are getting dangerously low and my joints feel like they are full of sand.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "low battery, heading to sleep"
